subject.title: fix: surface cron errors for empty isolated agent replies

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally treat a delivery-requested isolated cron completion with no reply and no recognized committed terminal effect as an error after the branch is rebased onto current `main`?
rationale: This is a deliberate compatibility change to cron completion status: the code and tests define the safe exclusions, but maintainers must confirm that the remaining former silent-success behavior is not a supported workflow.

options.title: Confirm the strict empty-completion guard
options.body: Rebase the branch, rerun the focused preservation and error-path proof, then land the guard so unsupported empty completions surface as cron failures.

options.title: Keep silent completion compatibility
options.body: Do not land the status change unless a broader compatibility mode or migration path is chosen for jobs that currently complete with empty output.

recommendation.title: Confirm the strict empty-completion guard
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, rerun the focused preservation and error-path proof, then land the guard so unsupported empty completions surface as cron failures.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest preservation commit and current assignment place this compatibility decision with the person actively carrying the cron patch.
